doctorView.documents: The documents you chose to share

hero.title: Your health information, connected.
hero.subtitle: Keep your records in your own words, have your documents read, and share exactly what you choose.

step1.title: You describe it
step1.body: Write what you are experiencing in your own language. Your words are stored exactly as you wrote them.

step2.title: Asclepius organises it
step2.body: It renders your words in English for your doctor and pulls out symptoms, medicines and measurements — each one carrying the words it came from.

step3.title: You confirm
step3.body: Nothing reaches your health record until you confirm it. Correct an item, or reject it, and the original still stands.

step4.title: You choose what to share
step4.body: Pick a doctor, then pick exactly which problems, records and documents they may see.

step5.title: Your doctor decides
step5.body: They read your original beside the organised version, then write their own assessment and prescription.

evidence.title: Every item points back at your words
evidence.body: Nothing reaches your health record until you confirm it. If Asclepius cannot show where something came from, it does not keep it.

documents.title: Documents, read page by page
documents.body: Upload a lab report or a discharge summary. Each page is read — copied from the PDF, or transcribed from a scan — and every value shows the line it came from.

languages.title: Write in the language you think in
languages.body: Your doctor reads it in theirs. The original always stays beside the translation.

doctor.title: What your doctor sees
doctor.body: Only what you shared, with its source visible: your original document, what was read from it, and what you confirmed. The clinical decision stays theirs.

trust.title: What Asclepius will not do
trust.consent: Nothing is processed without your consent.
trust.original: Your original words and files are never changed.
trust.decision: It never diagnoses, prescribes, or chooses between doctors.
